resolutionHint.excused: For a missing record or departure, the day counts as excused.
resolutionHint.absent: For a missing record or departure, the day counts as absent.
resolutionHint.dismissed: Closes the exception and leaves the day as it is.
resolutionHint.corrected: The punches were fixed (add the missing one first); the day is rebuilt from them.

settings.description: Shifts, the work patterns that plan each employee's week, and the attendance rules days are judged by.

shifts.description: A shift's hours and break. A shift that is rostered, worked or in a work pattern cannot be deleted; deactivate it instead.
shifts.name: Name
shifts.overnightHint: An end before the start runs past midnight.
shifts.deleteWarning: A shift that is rostered, worked or in a work pattern cannot be deleted.

patterns.description: How an employee's week is planned. An assignment names its work pattern; one in use cannot be deleted.

kindHint.fixed: The same shift on chosen weekdays; any other day is a rest day.
kindHint.roster: Each day is whatever the roster plans.
kindHint.flexible: A number of hours a week, at any time.

patterns.hoursAWeek: {n} hour a week | {n} hours a week
patterns.needsAShift: Choose a shift for at least one day.
patterns.deleteConfirm: Delete the work pattern {name}? A pattern assignments use cannot be deleted; deactivate it instead.

policies.description: The rules attendance days are judged by, from a date.

hints.grace: Minutes after the start before arriving counts as late.
hints.earlyLeaveGrace: Minutes before the end before leaving counts as early.
hints.minOvertime: Extra time shorter than this is not overtime.
hints.entryTolerance: A time an employee enters that card scans confirm within this many minutes needs no approval.

roster.description: A week of everyone's plan. Set a day to a shift, a day off, or back to the work pattern; save the changes together.
roster.empty: Nobody is employed in this week for this unit.
roster.discard: {n} change to this week will be lost. | {n} changes to this week will be lost.
roster.copyHint: Copies the roster of the week starting {from} onto the week starting the date you choose, for the same people.
roster.saveBeforeCopy: Save or discard this week's changes before copying it.
roster.copyOverwrites: Only days set by hand on the roster are copied; days that follow the work pattern are not. Those days are replaced in the target week.

days.description: Each day as attendance built it from punches and plans, and the exceptions it raised. A range is two months at most.

reprocess.title: Rebuild days
reprocess.hint: Rebuilds the attendance days of a range (two months at most) from punches and plans — after punches were added or a plan changed. Locked months stay as they are. With an employee filter set, only that employee.

requests.description: Times employees entered for a missed punch, and overtime requests. Both are decided through their approval flow; here HR reads them.

periods.description: Locking a month freezes its attendance; a regular payroll run is calculated only for a locked month. A month can be locked once it has ended, no exception in it is open and no time entry or overtime is pending — the server says what is left.
periods.empty: No month has been locked yet.
periods.lockConfirm: Its attendance days, punches and exceptions can no longer change, and payroll can then be calculated for it.
periods.unlockConfirm: Its attendance can change again. A payroll already calculated for it may no longer match.

card.title: Staff card
card.reissueConfirm: The current card stops working at once; the new one is shown once to print.
card.revokeConfirm: The card stops working at once; the employee can no longer punch with it.
card.printHint: This code is shown only now. Print it before closing; to replace it later, issue a new card.

punches.title: Punches
punches.addHint: A punch the employee missed, in the organisation's local time. It is recorded with your reason.

me.description: Your plan, your attendance, and the times and overtime you asked for.
me.entryHint: An arrival or departure you did not punch, for today or a past day. Card scans may confirm it; otherwise it goes for approval.
me.overtimeHint: Overtime goes for approval. Where it must be approved beforehand, ask before you work it.
me.noEntries: You have not entered any time.
me.noTeam: No direct reports on this day.
